archetypes.name: design-flow
archetypes.rationale: Combined wrappers change /design step sequencing and pause semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3b through Gate C orchestration as an end-to-end flow. Focus on whether wrapper-owned completion, pause-save behavior, rejected-findings emission, and skip-approve parsing preserve the documented state transitions. Check for mismatches between SKILL.md prose and script behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: classifier
archetypes.rationale: The new plan classifier decides whether diagrams are skipped.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 3b plan-heading classifier for conservative defaults. Focus on whitespace-tolerant heading parsing, backtick path handling, uppercase extensions, SKILL.md paths, and heading-free or malformed plans. Verify non-architectural plans are the only skipped case. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-contracts
archetypes.rationale: New Bash wrappers absorb prior prompt-side and split-wrapper behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Bash wrappers for macOS Bash 3.2 compatibility and strict-mode safety. Pay special attention to set -e behavior in helper functions, temp-file cleanup, run-log append-failure arguments, and stable marker output for prompt-side re-emission. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
